name: input_otp
title: Input OTP
description: A one-time code field shown as separate slots, with paste and SMS/email autofill support.

classes.name: input-otp
classes.description: The field. Holds groups of slots, optional separators and one <input>.

classes.name: input-otp__group
classes.description: Joins its slots into one box.

classes.name: input-otp__slot
classes.description: One character. Mark it data-input-otp-target="slot"; the number of slots is the code length.

classes.name: input-otp__separator
classes.description: Space between groups, e.g. with an icon--minus inside.

classes.name: input-otp__input
classes.description: The real input, laid invisibly over the slots.

attributes.name: data-input-otp-target="input"
attributes.description: The real field that is submitted. Give it a name and, if needed, required.

attributes.name: data-input-otp-pattern
attributes.description: Allowed characters: "digits" (default), "chars" (letters) or "digits-and-chars". Anything else typed or pasted is dropped.

events.name: velle:input-otp:complete
events.description: Dispatched when every slot is filled. event.detail.value is the code.

notes: The script sets maxlength to the number of slots, autocomplete="one-time-code" and an inputmode matching the pattern, unless the input already has them.
Characters are always added and removed at the end of the code.
Disable the input to disable the whole field.

examples.title: Submit when complete
examples.description: Combines velle:input-otp:complete with the form component.
